articles.summary: Teradata today announced the appointment of Peter Stadler as new Country Manager in Switzerland. Peter Stadler is responsible for the business in Switzerland since March 2020 and has more than 20 years of experience as manager in the IT industry.
articles.title: Teradata Appoints Peter Stadler as Country Manager Switzerland
